===Rewards Guardian===
{{Main|Rewards Guardian}}
[[File:Rewards Guardian.png|thumb|right|The Rewards Guardian.]]
Rewards from the Guardian include a standard loot table including runes and talismans, as well as various unique rewards.

{| class="wikitable lighttable align-center-1" style=width:700px;
! colspan="2" | Item
! Info
|-
| {{plinkt|Abyssal pearls}}
| Used to purchase items from the [[Temple Supplies]] shop.
|-
| {{plinkt|Intricate pouch}}
| Can give a [[tarnished locket]] or a [[lost bag]]. Grants a random amount of runes or one of several dragon items.  Also has a chance at granting a [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard clue]]. 
|-
| {{plinkt|Atlax's diary}}
| An old diary of someone's experiences at the Temple of the Eye.
|-
| {{plinkt|Elemental talisman}}
| Grants access to all elemental [[runic altar]]s.
|-
| {{plinkt|Catalytic talisman}}
| Grants access to all catalytic runic altars, provided the player has completed the quests to access those that require it.
|-
| {{plinkt|Abyssal needle}}
| Combines all [[essence pouch]]es into one [[colossal pouch]] ({{SCP|Crafting|56|link=yes}} required). If the colossal pouch is lost, players may simply use a normal needle on the Rewards Guardian to obtain another Abyssal needle.
|-
| {{plinkt|Abyssal lantern}}
| Gives various benefits within the minigame depending on the type of logs used to light it. Can also be purchased with 1500 pearls.
|-
| {{nowrap|{{plinkp|Abyssal red dye}} {{plinkp|Abyssal green dye}} {{plinkp|Abyssal blue dye}}}}
| [[Abyssal dye]]s
| Recolours the [[raiments of the eye]], [[lost bag]], and [[amulet of the eye]]. Comes in [[Abyssal red dye|red]], [[Abyssal green dye|green]], and [[Abyssal blue dye|blue]].
|-
| {{plinkt|Abyssal protector}}
| An abyssal creature pet, similar to an [[Abyssal guardian (Guardians of the Rift)|abyssal guardian]].
